questions.text: What is the register map (offset, width, reset value and access of every register) for the UART test shell?
questions.default: 0x00 ID, 32 bit, RO, reset 0x53454731 (ASCII SEG1); 0x04 COUNT, 32 bit field with bits 15:0 used, RO, reset 0x00000000 (binary count)
questions.reason: the request names shell register reads and the design ID but gives no offsets, so the proposed two-register map is used until answered
questions.answer: 0x00 ID, 32 bit, RO, reset 0x53454731 (ASCII SEG1); 0x04 COUNT, 32 bit field with bits 15:0 used, RO, reset 0x00000000 (binary count)

questions.text: How many digits does the counter display and what is the maximum count?
questions.reason: the request says decimal display but does not give a width; four digits fits the count range and leaves the other four anodes off

questions.text: Are leading zeros displayed or blanked?
questions.default: leading zeros are displayed, so 42 shows 0042
questions.reason: a fixed four-digit counter reads most clearly with zeros, and blanking would need an extra rule
questions.answer: leading zeros are displayed, so 42 shows 0042

questions.text: What are the UART baud rate, data bits, parity and stop bits?
questions.default: 115200 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit, BAUD_DIV_CYCLES 868
questions.reason: 115200 8N1 is the usual default for the Nexys USB-UART bridge and the request gives no rate
questions.answer: 115200 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit, BAUD_DIV_CYCLES 868

questions.text: What is the framing of a shell read request and response?
questions.default: one request byte 'r' followed by one offset byte, response is four bytes most significant first
questions.reason: the request does not define the protocol and a simple fixed frame is the smallest one that reads a 32 bit register
questions.answer: one request byte 'r' followed by one offset byte, response is four bytes most significant first

questions.text: Does the centre button clear only the count, or also restart the one-second phase?
questions.default: clear sets the count to 0 and restarts the tick counter so the next increment is one full second later
questions.reason: restarting the phase makes the first second after a clear exactly one second long
questions.answer: clear sets the count to 0 and restarts the tick counter so the next increment is one full second later

questions.text: What debounce time is used for btnc?
questions.reason: 10 ms is a common mechanical bounce window and the request gives no value

questions.text: Can the count be cleared from the UART shell as well as by btnc?
questions.default: no, the shell is read only
questions.reason: the request asks only for reading the count over the shell
questions.answer: no, the shell is read only

questions.text: Is the count stable during a multi-byte read or can it change between bytes?
questions.default: no snapshot: the 16 bit count may change between bytes of a read, with the value read from the live register
questions.reason: a snapshot register would add state the request does not ask for; a one-second update rate makes a mid-read change rare
questions.answer: no snapshot: the 16 bit count may change between bytes of a read, with the value read from the live register

questions.text: What is the digit scan rate?
questions.default: SCAN_CYCLES 100000 (1 ms per digit slot, about 125 Hz full frame)
questions.reason: 1 ms per slot avoids visible flicker with four digits and the request gives no value
questions.answer: SCAN_CYCLES 100000 (1 ms per digit slot, about 125 Hz full frame)
